title: Power Automate alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Power Automate alternatives: UiPath for desktop RPA, Zapier and Make for non-Microsoft apps, n8n to self-host, and 50agents to build from plain words.
answer: If you need desktop RPA beyond Power Automate's, UiPath is the enterprise alternative with a free Community plan; if most of your apps are not Microsoft's, Zapier and Make connect more of them.
If you want to self-host, n8n runs on your own servers; if the people who need automations will not learn a flow designer, 50agents builds them from plain words.
ask: Keep track of customer requests and draft the replies
lede: The licence is the usual reason: premium connectors, which cover many non-Microsoft apps, need a Premium licence for every user.

entries.suits: Teams outside IT who need jobs done in their web apps. Captain builds the automation, tests it on a real event and shows you before it goes live.
entries.limit: No desktop RPA and no Windows apps. It works with web apps and websites, not software installed on your PC.

entries.suits: Enterprises whose automation runs on robots and AI agents, built in UiPath Studio and run with Maestro.
entries.price: Community: free forever. Basic: from $25 a month
entries.limit: Above Basic, Standard and Enterprise prices are only through sales.

entries.suits: Teams whose apps are mostly not Microsoft's. Zapier lists 10,541+ apps, with code steps for the edges.
entries.price: Free: 100 tasks a month. Professional: $19.99 a month billed yearly (750 tasks)
entries.limit: Each action step is a task, so long flows use up a plan quickly.

entries.suits: Teams who like a visual designer but want 3,500+ apps and a free plan of 1,000 credits a month.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits a month. Core: from $9 a month (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: Most actions cost a credit each, and it works with cloud apps, not desktop ones.

entries.suits: IT teams who want automations inside their own network, with a Code node and human approval for AI tool calls.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: Your team runs and upgrades the server; the cloud version has no free plan.

entries.suits: Small teams who want a flat price, not per user, for up to 5 users, and the option to self-host.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits, up to 5 users. Plus: $20 a month flat (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: It lists 770+ apps, fewer than Power Automate's 1,400+ connectors.

us: The people who need automations are not in IT and will not learn a flow designer.
Your work is in web apps, and many of them are not Microsoft's.
You want AI agents and small apps alongside the automations.
them: You automate old Windows apps with no API. Desktop flows do that, and cloud tools do not.
Your work lives in Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Excel, and the free licence with standard connectors covers it.
You use approvals and process mining inside Microsoft 365; nothing else here plugs in as deeply.

move.title: Export flows as packages
move.body: Power Automate exports a flow as a package (.zip) or inside a solution. Keep them; they import back into Power Automate only.

move.title: Move the premium-connector flows first
move.body: Flows that force a Premium licence are where the savings are. Desktop flows usually stay.

move.title: Reconnect Microsoft apps in the new tool
move.body: Outlook, OneDrive and Teams connections are made again in the new tool with your Microsoft account; check your admin allows it.

move.title: Turn flows off, then reduce licences
move.body: Turn each flow off once its replacement has run a week, then drop Premium licences at renewal.

faqs.a: Microsoft describes a free licence for work or school accounts: cloud flows without sharing, with standard connectors only. Premium is $15.00 per user a month, paid yearly.

faqs.q: What is the best alternative to Power Automate Desktop?
faqs.a: UiPath, for desktop RPA. Cloud tools such as Zapier, Make and 50agents do not automate Windows apps.

faqs.q: How many connectors does Power Automate have?
faqs.a: Microsoft's product page says more than 1,400 prebuilt, certified connectors. Zapier lists 10,541+ apps and Make 3,500+.
